run_vanilla_sweep: run vanilla_sweep to generate ensemble configurations with num_ensemble values of 1, 3, 10, 30, 100
run_weight_sweep: run weight_sweep to generate ensemble configurations with adaptive_weight_scale and l2_weight_decay hyperparameters
run_batch_sweep: run batch_sweep to generate ensemble configurations with batch_strategy and num_batches hyperparameters
run_combined_sweep: run combined_sweep to generate ensemble configurations combining vanilla, weight, and batch sweeps
run_paper_agent: run paper_agent to create a PaperAgent with default VanillaEnsembleConfig, make_agent constructor, and combined_sweep
